name: Tooi
source:
He fell onto the mountain behind Central High School.

A mysterious existence sleeping in the space shuttle. He is blunt, straightforward, and very powerful.

He can't remember his past and purpose.

"I am the 101st person called "Tooi"."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
